summary: Red Bull enters the Bahrain Grand Prix as the team to beat after dominating early practice, with George Russell and Charles Leclerc already conceding the Redbulls' superior pace heading into Saturday's qualifying. Ferrari and Mercedes will battle for second-best position throughout the weekend, forced to chase Max Verstappen and Sergio Pérez in a heat-hazard race that demands flawless tire management and pit strategy. A commanding performance here could extend Red Bull's championship lead decisively, while any stumble opens the door for their rivals to claw back crucial points in the championship fight.
